content_sections.heading: About IIT Kanpur
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is a public technical institute in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. This post belongs to the institute's National Aerosol Facility, which is coordinated by Prof. Sachchida Nand Tripathi. The notice sends readers to the ATMAN group page for details about the research group.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Research Analyst Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice prints the salary as "INR 31600-2600-78400 per month consolidated". It also says the salary will be "commensurate with experience & skills". content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Research Analyst Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Postgraduate in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) or a relevant field + 3 years relevant experience. Working knowledge of Python for data processing and analysis. Basic understanding of AI/ML, statistical methods and data visualization. Interest in environmental data analysis and establishing a career in research. Good analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. Basic proficiency in MS Office and the ability to work independently and in a team. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details for this post.

content_sections.heading: Duties and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Process, analyze and interpret environmental and scientific datasets using Python and statistical techniques. Perform data quality checks and find trends and patterns in air-quality and environmental data. Prepare graphs, dashboards and technical reports to communicate findings. Support the development of analytical workflows and AI/ML-based tools for environmental data visualization. Maintain project records and carry out other related research and technical work as assigned.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is temporary and on contract. The appointment lasts 1 year or until the project ends, whichever comes first. It is renewed every year based on performance.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The department reserves the right to set its own criteria for shortlisting eligible candidates who meet the qualification and experience requirements. Selection is by interview, which may be held online, in person, or both. Shortlisted candidates will be told the interview date by email.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Analyst posts has IIT Kanpur advertised?
faq.answer: There is one post, at the National Aerosol Facility under advertisement number P.Rect./R&D/2026/218.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification do I need?
faq.answer: You need a postgraduate degree in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) or a relevant field and 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. Which technical skills does the post require?
faq.answer: You need a working knowledge of Python for data processing and analysis. You also need a basic understanding of AI/ML, statistical methods and data visualization, and basic proficiency in MS Office.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Analyst?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary is printed as INR 31600-2600-78400. Your exact pay will depend on your experience and skills.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is temporary and on contract. It lasts 1 year or until the project ends, whichever comes first, and is renewed every year based on performance.

faq.question: Q6. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Put the post applied for and the advertisement number, for example "Research Analyst - P.Rect./R&D/2026/218".

faq.question: Q7. Do I need to send a GitHub link?
faq.answer: Yes. A link to your GitHub repository of previous projects is mandatory. You must also send your CV, a cover letter, contact details for 2 references and writing samples.

faq.question: Q8. How will the interview be held?
faq.answer: Interviews may be online, in person or both. Shortlisted candidates will get the interview date by email.

faq.question: Q9. What work does the Research Analyst do?
faq.answer: The analyst processes and interprets air-quality and environmental datasets, runs data quality checks, prepares graphs, dashboards and technical reports, and helps build AI/ML-based tools for environmental data visualization.
